scripts.text:
[Vomars]
You have my blessings, have a wonderful married life.
scripts.translation:
[沃馬斯]
祝福你們，願你們婚後生活幸福美滿。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
You must apply for
marriage with Happy Marry
before you can get married.
Happy Marry will let you know
what else you'll need to do
to prepare for marriage
scripts.translation:
[沃馬斯]
結婚前，你得先找快樂婚禮辦理結婚申請。
對方會告訴你還需要做哪些準備。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
Here's the wedding ring for your bride.
I will now start the wedding ceremony, and you will be declared forth husband and wife.
scripts.translation:
[沃馬斯]
這是給你新娘的結婚戒指。
現在我將開始婚禮儀式，宣佈你們正式結為夫妻。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
{0}, {1} has requested to be your wife for the rest of your life. Do you accept?
scripts.translation:
[沃馬斯]
{0}，{1}願意成為你的妻子，與你共度一生。你願意嗎？

scripts.text: I need time to think about it.
scripts.translation: 我還需要考慮一下

scripts.text: No, I don't!
scripts.translation: 不，我不願意！

scripts.text: Yes, I do!
scripts.translation: 是的，我願意！

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
Now that you both have accepted, the wedding will begin. Please come forth, you and your partner, to retrieve your rings.
scripts.translation:
[沃馬斯]
既然你們都同意了，婚禮就要開始了。請兩位上前領取戒指。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
!!
Ah... err... ehm... okay. You two seem to have some differences to settle first.
scripts.translation:
[沃馬斯]
！！
啊...呃...嗯...好吧。看來你們倆還有些分歧需要先解決一下。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
I will now start the wedding ceremony, and you will be declared forth husband and wife.
scripts.translation:
[沃馬斯]
現在我將開始婚禮儀式，宣佈你們正式結為夫妻。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
Child, what did you do with your {0}?
scripts.translation:
[沃馬斯]
孩子，你把你的{0}弄到哪裡去了？

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
Child, you are supposed to wear a {0} at all times during the ceremony...
scripts.translation:
[沃馬斯]
孩子，儀式期間你必須一直穿著{0}...

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
Child, you can't take off your {0} yet....
scripts.translation:
[沃馬斯]
孩子，你現在還不能脫下{0}....

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
What happened to your {0}? You didn't lose it... did you? We need it to continue with the ceremony!
scripts.translation:
[沃馬斯]
你的{0}怎麼了？你沒把它弄丟吧...？我們還得用它繼續儀式！

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
You don't seem to have enough space to carry the ring... go free up some space and come back to reclaim your partner's ring.
scripts.translation:
[沃馬斯]
你的背包似乎放不下戒指了...先去騰出些空間，再來領取給你伴侶的戒指。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
Where is {0}?? I can't marry you both if one is missing...
scripts.translation:
[沃馬斯]
{0}在哪兒？？少了一個人，我就沒法為你們主持婚禮...

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
Where is {0}?? I can't marry you both if one is missing...
scripts.translation:
[沃馬斯]
{0}在哪兒？？少了一個人，我就沒法為你們主持婚禮...

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
Here's the wedding ring for your bride.
Once your bride retrieves the ring, the ceremony will begin.
scripts.translation:
[沃馬斯]
這是給你新娘的結婚戒指。
等新娘領取戒指後，儀式就會開始。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
You what!?
err.. *cough* *cough* very well... come back after you've made up your mind.
scripts.translation:
[沃馬斯]
你說什麼！？
呃...*咳嗽* *咳嗽* 好吧...等你想好了再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
After your bride approves, you will be given your rings, the ceremony will begin and you will be officially married.
scripts.translation:
[沃馬斯]
等新娘也同意後，你們就能領取戒指，開始儀式，正式結為夫妻。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
Looks like your bride has yet to arrive and register.
scripts.translation:
[沃馬斯]
看來你的新娘還沒來登記。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
Please don't interrupt me now.
scripts.translation:
[沃馬斯]
現在請不要打擾我。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
Your partner's wedding ring hasn't been retrieved yet. The ceremony will start as soon as you both have claimed your rings.
scripts.translation:
[沃馬斯]
你的伴侶還沒領取結婚戒指。等你們雙方都領到戒指，儀式就能開始。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
I am waiting for your partner to accept you to start the ceremony.
scripts.translation:
[沃馬斯]
我在等你的伴侶同意與你結婚，然後才能開始儀式。

I will now start the wedding ceremony, and you will be declared forth husband and wife.

scripts.translation:

正在籌備婚禮。請不要打擾我。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
I am wedding {0} and {1}, and it's already too late to object. Please let me continue.
scripts.translation:
[沃馬斯]
我正在為{0}和{1}主持婚禮，現在反對已經太遲了。請讓我繼續。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
I am going to wed {0} and {1}, do you have an objection to it?
Very well, go sit and enjoy the ceremony.
scripts.translation:
[沃馬斯]
我要為{0}和{1}主持婚禮，你有異議嗎？
很好，請入座欣賞儀式吧。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
I am going to wed {0} and {1}, do you have an objection to it?
Why should they not be wed?
I see...
scripts.translation:
[沃馬斯]
我要為{0}和{1}主持婚禮，你有異議嗎？
他們為什麼不應該結婚？
我明白了...

scripts.text: Sorry, please go on.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，請繼續

scripts.text: Yes, I actually do.
scripts.translation: 是的，我有異議

scripts.text:
[Marry]
Isn't marriage beautiful?
scripts.translation:
[快樂婚禮]
婚姻難道不美好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Marry]
{0} is waiting for the groom to register. Are you the one who came to register as groom?
scripts.translation:
[快樂婚禮]
{0}正在等新郎登記。你是來登記的新郎嗎？

scripts.text:
[Marry]
{0} is waiting for the bride to register. Are you the one who came to register as the bride?
scripts.translation:
[快樂婚禮]
{0}正在等新娘登記。你是來登記的新娘嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I am.
scripts.translation: 是的，我是

scripts.text: Sorry, you got the wrong person.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，你認錯人了

scripts.text:
[Marry]
There is a wedding in progress.
Would you like to know the progress of said wedding?
scripts.translation:
[快樂婚禮]
婚禮正在進行中。
你想了解這場婚禮的進度嗎？

scripts.text:
[Marry]
Before registering as groom, let me check if you meet all the requirements...
scripts.translation:
[快樂婚禮]
登記為新郎之前，讓我先檢查一下你是否符合所有要求...

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Marry]
Before registering as bride, let me check if you meet all the requirements...
scripts.translation:
[快樂婚禮]
登記為新娘之前，讓我先檢查一下你是否符合所有要求...

scripts.text:
[Marry]
Very well, now go to the Priest to reaffirm your vows and the ceremony will begin.
scripts.translation:
[快樂婚禮]
很好，現在去找牧師重申誓言，儀式就要開始了。

scripts.text:
[Marry]
The groom, {0}, is waiting for the bride to retrieve the ring.
The bride, {1}, has yet to retrieve the ring.
scripts.translation:

新娘{1}還沒有領取戒指。

scripts.text:

scripts.text: Enjoy the remaining of the wedding.

scripts.text:
[Marry]

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.text:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[快樂婚禮]

scripts.text:
[Marry]
You should be wearing a {0} if you want to get married.
scripts.translation:
[快樂婚禮]

scripts.text:
[Marry]
Where is your {0}? It's a necessary complement to your dress.
scripts.translation:

你的{0}呢？這是禮服必不可少的配飾。

scripts.text:
[Marry]
Where's the ring? You need a {0} for the ring exchange, dear.
scripts.translation:
[快樂婚禮]
戒指呢？親愛的，交換戒指時需要一枚{0}。

scripts.text:
[Marry]
I am sorry, but you don't have enough to pay for the registration fee.
Come back once you have collected {0}z.
scripts.translation:
[快樂婚禮]

攢夠{0}z後再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Marry]
I see. Sorry to have bothered you then.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
[Marry]
Marriage... is such a beautiful thing.
Would you like to get married with someone?
scripts.translation:
[快樂婚禮]
婚姻...真是一件美好的事。
你想和某人結婚嗎？

scripts.text: I'll be single forever!
scripts.translation: 我要永遠單身！

scripts.text: Explain the principles of marriage.
scripts.translation: 瞭解婚姻原則

scripts.text: Explain the marriage procedure.
scripts.translation: 瞭解結婚流程

scripts.text: I want to get married with someone.
scripts.translation: 我想結婚

scripts.text:
[Marry]
In that case, enjoy your bachelor's life.
scripts.translation:
[快樂婚禮]
既然如此，就好好享受你的單身生活吧。

scripts.text:
[Marry]
Weddings are performed by our local Priest with the intent of promoting love and peace among the loving couples.
scripts.translation:
[快樂婚禮]
婚禮由當地牧師主持，旨在讓相愛的伴侶彼此珍愛、和睦相處。

scripts.text:
[Marry]
The proposal must be done with prudence and courtesy, once the wedlocks have been made, they cannot be undone.
scripts.translation:
[快樂婚禮]
求婚時要慎重有禮。一旦結為夫妻，就不能解除婚姻。

scripts.text:
[Marry]
The two who have been joined by marriage must remain together forever until the day death do them apart.
scripts.translation:
[快樂婚禮]
結為夫妻的兩人必須終生相守，直到死亡將他們分開。

scripts.text:
[Marry]
Males may only wed with females, and females only with males, the church will not consent any other kind of partnerships.
scripts.translation:
[快樂婚禮]
男性只能娶女性，女性只能嫁男性，教會不會同意其他形式的結合。

scripts.text:
[Marry]
Although normally only males can wed females (and vice versa), our local Priest is more open-minded than that and he permits all pairings regardless of gender.
scripts.translation:
[快樂婚禮]
通常只能由男女雙方結為夫妻，不過我們這裡的牧師思想比較開明，無論性別，都可以在這裡結婚。

scripts.text:
[Marry]
If there is a significant other with whom you want to spend the rest of your life with, then don't be shy to propose.
scripts.translation:
[快樂婚禮]
如果有想要共度餘生的人，就別害羞，大膽求婚吧。

scripts.text:
[Marry]
I wish for many blessings upon couples who wish to live happily ever after...
scripts.translation:
[快樂婚禮]
願所有想要白頭偕老的伴侶都得到滿滿的祝福...

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Marry]
I shouldn't need to mention this, but adopted kids are too young to get married.
Both groom and bride must register within a minute of each other, or the wedding will be cancelled. So be sure you both are ready and meet the registration requirements beforehand.
scripts.translation:
[快樂婚禮]
雖然應該不用我提醒，但被收養的孩子年紀還小，不能結婚。
新郎和新娘登記的時間不能相差超過一分鐘，否則婚禮就會取消。所以，請事先做好準備，確保雙方都符合登記要求。

scripts.text:
[Marry]

scripts.translation:
[快樂婚禮]
只要雙方都同意結婚，婚禮就確定了，儀式也即將開始。

scripts.text:
[Marry]
If you both accept each other, then the wedding has been decided and the ceremony will begin.
But first, you need to get your rings ready.
scripts.translation:
[快樂婚禮]
只要雙方都同意結婚，婚禮就確定了，儀式也即將開始。
不過，得先準備好戒指。

scripts.text:
[Marry]
If there are various couples who desire to marry, you should keep in order, for the Priest can only handle one wedding at a time.
scripts.translation:
[快樂婚禮]
如果有多對伴侶想結婚，請按順序等候，牧師一次只能主持一場婚禮。

scripts.text:
[Marry]
Talk to the priest once more, and he will exchange your {0} for a wedding ring. After you both have claimed the rings for exchanging, the ceremony will begin.
scripts.translation:
[快樂婚禮]
再和牧師交談一次，他會用你的{0}換一枚結婚戒指。等你們雙方都領到用於交換的戒指，儀式就會開始。

scripts.text:
[Marry]
Very well, whom would you like to register as?
scripts.translation:
[快樂婚禮]
好，你想登記為新郎還是新娘？

scripts.text:
[Marry]
Very well, will you register as the Bride?
scripts.translation:
[快樂婚禮]
好的，你要登記為新娘嗎？

scripts.text:
[Marry]
Very well, will you register as the Groom?
scripts.translation:
[快樂婚禮]
好的，你要登記為新郎嗎？

scripts.text: Groom
scripts.translation: 新郎

scripts.text: Bride
scripts.translation: 新娘

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: I've changed my mind.
scripts.translation: 我改變主意了

scripts.text:
[Marry]
Before registering as groom, let me check if you meet all the requirements...
scripts.translation:
[快樂婚禮]
登記為新郎之前，讓我先檢查一下你是否符合所有要求...

scripts.text:
[Marry]
Before registering as bride, let me check if you meet all the requirements...
scripts.translation:
[快樂婚禮]
登記為新娘之前，讓我先檢查一下你是否符合所有要求...

scripts.text:
[Marry]
Oh dear, you are too young to be thinking of marriage!
scripts.translation:
[快樂婚禮]
哎呀，你還太小，現在可不能考慮結婚！

scripts.text:
[Marry]
You should be wearing a {0} if you want to get married.
scripts.translation:
[快樂婚禮]
想結婚的話，你必須穿著{0}。

scripts.text:
[Marry]
Where is your {0}? It's a necessary complement to your dress.
scripts.translation:
[快樂婚禮]
你的{0}呢？這是禮服必不可少的配飾。

scripts.text:
[Marry]
Where's the ring? You need a {0} for the ring exchange, dear.
scripts.translation:
[快樂婚禮]
戒指呢？親愛的，交換戒指時需要一枚{0}。

scripts.text:
[Marry]
I am sorry, but you don't have enough to pay for the registration fee.
Come back once you have collected {0}z.
scripts.translation:
[快樂婚禮]
很抱歉，你的錢不夠支付登記費。
攢夠{0}z後再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Marry]
Come back when you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[快樂婚禮]
等你準備好了再回來吧。

scripts.text:
[Marry]
You are now registered as the groom.
Tell your bride to register as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[快樂婚禮]
你現在已登記為新郎。
請讓你的新娘儘快來登記。

scripts.text:
[Marry]
You are now registered as the bride.
Tell your groom to register as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[快樂婚禮]
你現在已登記為新娘。
請讓你的新郎儘快來登記。

scripts.text:
[Lisa]
Divorcing can be such a sad event...
You wouldn't want to divorce, by any chance?
scripts.translation:
[莉莎]
離婚真是件令人難過的事...
你該不會是想離婚吧？

scripts.text:
[Lisa]
Divorcing can be such a sad event...
People shouldn't make shallow vows to others, don't you think?
scripts.translation:
[莉莎]
離婚真是件令人難過的事...
人不該隨隨便便向別人許下誓言，你說是不是？

scripts.text: I am happy as I am, thank you.
scripts.translation: 我現在很幸福，謝謝

scripts.text: Explain the divorce.
scripts.translation: 瞭解離婚流程

scripts.text: Explain Requirements.
scripts.translation: 瞭解離婚要求

scripts.text: I want to divorce.
scripts.translation: 我想離婚

scripts.text:
[Lisa]
Good to hear.
scripts.translation:
[莉莎]
那就好。

scripts.text:
[Lisa]
Even though it is said that once the wedlocks have been made they cannot be undone, sometimes it is necessary to undo our mistakes from the past..
scripts.translation:
[莉莎]
雖然常說婚姻一旦締結便無法解除，但有時為了糾正過去的錯誤，解除婚姻也是必要的...

scripts.text:
[Lisa]
It is sad, but true. If you happen to have married the wrong person, it is possible to divorce, rather than spend the rest of your life with the wrong one.
scripts.translation:
[莉莎]
這雖然令人難過，卻是事實。如果結婚時選錯了人，可以選擇離婚，不必和不合適的人共度餘生。

scripts.text:
[Lisa]
In order to file for divorce, I need you both to agree to it.
After you file in for divorce, your spouse has one minute to agree, and then you will both be divorced.
scripts.translation:
[莉莎]
離婚需要雙方同意。
你提交離婚申請後，配偶必須在一分鐘內確認，之後才能解除婚姻。

scripts.text:
[Lisa]
In order to file for divorce, I need you both to agree to it.
After you file in for divorce, your spouse has one minute to agree, and then you will both be divorced.
The fee is of {0}z and is paid by the person who confirms the divorce, so plan ahead of time how you will divide the costs.
scripts.translation:
[莉莎]
辦理離婚需要雙方同意。
提交離婚申請後，你的配偶必須在一分鐘內確認，之後你們才會正式離婚。
費用為{0}z，由確認離婚的一方支付，請提前商量好如何分擔。

scripts.text:
[Lisa]
You should not regret the choices you've made in life.
Are you positively sure about getting divorced?
scripts.translation:
[莉莎]
人生中的選擇，不該讓自己後悔。
你真的確定要離婚嗎？

scripts.text: Wait... I need to think about it.
scripts.translation: 等等...我還需要想想

scripts.text: Absolutely
scripts.translation: 絕對確定

scripts.text:
[Lisa]
You should think this through.
scripts.translation:
[莉莎]
你應該好好考慮清楚。

scripts.text:
[Lisa]
Very well, get your partner to confirm, and I will collect the fee for filing the divorce then.
scripts.translation:
[莉莎]
好，請讓你的伴侶來確認，到時我會收取離婚費用。
